summary: Re-test of 3 mobile fixes from iteration_118 at 375px viewport. All 3 issues are now resolved.

issues: The two seat spans ('4 OF 12 SEATS FILLED THIS COHORT' and '8 REMAINING') are correctly separate elements in a flex space-between container, but at 375px with 0.524rem font-size (~8px) both spans together fill the full width making the text visually appear to run together. This is a pre-existing design concern (extremely small font) but the structural fix is correct.

hero_mobile_cta_depth.details: '.hero-sticky-bar' is display:flex, position:fixed, bottom:0px at 375px. data-testid='mobile-sticky-reach-cta' has href='/reach-diagnostic' and text 'Run REACH Diagnostic'. Bar is display:none on desktop (1280px).

hero_boot_lines_clutter.details: All 3 .hero-boot-line elements and the .hero-scan-init-label element compute to display:none at 375px via CSS media query max-width:680px.

admission_text_concat.details: Two separate <span> elements in a flex div with justify-content:space-between. Left: '4 of 12 seats filled this cohort', Right: '8 remaining'. Not concatenated.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 mobile issues from iteration_118 are fixed and verified at 375px. Sticky bar shows at bottom of mobile viewport with correct CTA, boot-log lines hidden on mobile, admission seats text in separate flex elements.
